items.text: Puka Nacua listed IN for Sunday after hip injury; expected to return vs Eagles.
items.why: ETR Sunday injury list; Schefter notes expected to play, Donald OUT.
items.implication: WR upgrade, potential volume return in Rams offense.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets rebound possible though snaps may be limited.

items.text: Justin Jefferson OUT (ankle); also listed with Jordan Mason.
items.why: ETR OUT list; Schefter and RapSheet confirm sprained ankle.
items.implication: Major WR1 absence; boosts other Vikings pass-catchers.
items.opportunity: Increased targets for Addison home vs soft secondary.

items.text: Devonta Smith and Dallas Goedert OUT (hamstring/other); Eagles missing key pieces vs Rams.
items.why: ETR OUT; Schefter ruled Smith out hamstring, Goedert too; Baun also out.
items.implication: Eagles offense weakened; Hurts/Brown usage shifts.
items.opportunity: More targets to remaining WRs/TEs; worse overall efficiency.

items.why: ETR IN; RapSheet confirms good to go.
items.implication: Elite WR return in strong DvP spot vs Cowboys.
items.opportunity: Full routes/targets expected; Texans high implied points.

items.text: Puka Nacua back great but possible snap limits; Nico Collins excellent return spot as Cowboys inflate WR scoring 7.3% most in NFL, Texans 7th-most implied points.
items.why: Hip return speculation on limits; hamstring + elite DvP data.
items.implication: Start both with confidence; Collins high ceiling.
items.opportunity: Nacua volume TBD; Collins full target share likely.

items.text: Jordan Addison opportunity peaks home vs borderline secondary with Jefferson out; Eagles worse without Smith/Goedert/Baun vs Rams.
items.why: Jefferson absence creates target vacuum; Eagles missing three key players.
items.implication: Addison smash spot; fade Eagles pass efficiency.
items.opportunity: Addison routes/targets spike; Eagles role contraction.

items.text: Breece Hall OUT; also AD Mitchell etc.
items.opportunity: Snaps/carries to backups like Braelon Allen.

items.why: ETR OUT list; reports of ACL tear/IR.

items.text: Jadarian Price OUT (chest); Charbonnet also listed.
items.why: ETR OUT; Levitan notes chest injury + role erosion.
items.implication: Seahawks RB depth chart shifts short-term.
items.opportunity: Goal-line/pass work already lost; Charbonnet practice return.

items.text: Jayden Daniels OUT (elbow); Rachaad White too.
items.opportunity: Pass game continuity risk; McLaurin Q.

items.text: LOVE Jaylen Warren: 90% snaps last week, 20/22 RB touches with Dowdle out; CLE allows 88+ rush yards every game.
items.why: Workhorse role locked; matchup soft vs run.

items.text: LOVE Jeremiyah Love (26 touches, RB5 util, Giants allow 5.1 YPC) and Drake London (35%+ TS with Penix, 43.5% last week, NO soft vs WR TDs).
items.why: Love volume spike + matchup; London Penix chemistry + target share.
items.opportunity: Love double-digit targets/carries; London high TS.

items.text: Jadarian Price tough runout: lost GL/base to Wilson, pass to Holani, fumbles, chest hurt, Charbonnet practicing; still passes eye test long-term.
items.why: Multiple role losses + injury + backup practice.
items.implication: Short-term fade; long-term hold for eye-test upside.

items.text: HATE Omarion Hampton (low util 3.5% TS, 42% snaps, SEA 2.9 YPC allowed) and Emeka Egbuka (new QB start, low RZ, low implied total).
items.why: Hampton usage collapse + tough run D; Egbuka environment poor.
items.opportunity: Hampton third-down/snap erosion; Egbuka limited opportunity.
